attribution: Made with Natural Earth. Public domain.
precision: Coordinates rounded to 0.001 degrees. Outer polygon rings only; holes omitted.

units.gdp: current USD millions, historical reference year specified by gdpYear

caveats: Country statistics are historical, mostly 2019, and must not be presented as 2026 observations.
Canada, Antarctica and Northern Cyprus could not be extracted because source lines exceeded web retrieval output limits and are omitted.
Natural Earth boundaries include disputed and dependent territories and are a cartographic convention, not an endorsement of territorial claims.
USA demographic and GDP reference fields reconstructed as 2019 estimates after a source line omission; polygon, ISO3, label position validated from remaining USA source record.
